threads.text: How notice to owner intention dey work for Anambra: quit notice don expire, but court work never start. Landlord must give seven clear days notice of intention to apply to court. Self-help no follow at all. Did your landlord serve seven days?
threads.evening: Anambra law no allow landlord jump straight to court once quit notice finish. That seven clear days paper must land first.

short.title: After the notice expires
short.hook_sub: Landlord cannot skip seven days notice
short.hook_say: Your quit notice has expired and your landlord is already knocking to throw your things out. The law says court does not start like that.

tips.sub: Quit notice expiring is not final
tips.say: In Anambra, after a quit notice expires, the landlord must still serve a separate seven clear days notice before heading to court.
Seven clear days means the date the paper was handed to you is not counted. The notice cannot run before the quit notice ends.
A landlord cannot throw bags out or change locks. Self-help is an unlawful eviction and courts make landlords pay heavy damages for it.
Never rely on verbal warnings. Landlords and tenants can generate valid, dated legal notices on DocOga in two minutes, completely free to start.
